subject: SIG request: FinWave security intake and section ownership
messages:
From: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@finwave.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finwave.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG request + baseline evidence need

Hi Markus —

We’re beginning vendor intake for FinWave’s payments platform and Redwood is in scope. Attached is the initial SIG questionnaire (SIG_v1.pdf) — the security team asked for the completed SIG and an evidence map by EOD next Tuesday (2026-12-08).

High level asks:
- Completed SIG matrix (we can use a point-based answer set)
- Evidence files referenced in the SIG (network diagram, SOC summary, config screenshots)
- A single owner per SIG section for follow-up Q&A

Can you confirm who on your team will own section-level responses and whether the evidence matrix (evidence_matrix.xlsx) can be populated by next Tuesday?

Thanks,
Lisa Grant
Security Program Manager
FinWave Financial

Attachment: SIG_v1.pdf (PDF questionnaire, 220 pages)
Attachment: evidence_matrix.xlsx (blank template)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@finwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG request + baseline evidence need

Hi Lisa —

Thanks for the SIG and clear deadline. We can meet the request, but to be transparent some sections will need direct input from infra/ops owners. I've looped in Marissa, Mina, and Soojin to coordinate owners and evidence pulls. Proposed plan:

1) Intake triage today — identify section owners and flag any missing artifacts.
2) Marissa to coordinate evidence collection for infra/ops sections.
3) Mina to handle application/security controls and compile screenshots/log extracts.
4) Soojin to manage the final assembly and quality check the matrix before submission.

Marissa/Team — can you confirm owners by EOD today and whether you need SLAs for any artifacts? I will be the executive contact for FinWave and will handle any escalations.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SIG_v1.pdf (forwarded)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

All — quick intake notes after scanning the SIG:

- Sections that likely map to infra/network (S07-S12) — owner: Jonas Weber (network diagram, firewall rules, VPC flow logs)
- Identity & access management (S03-S06) — owner: Mina Haddad (IAM policies, provisioning docs)
- Data protection & encryption (S13-S17) — owner: Marissa Cole (KMS screenshots, key rotation SOP)
- Incident response & logging (S18-S22) — joint ownership: Mina + Jonas (alerts, playbooks)
- Vendor/subproc controls (S23-S25) — owner: Soojin Lee (vendor audit artifacts)

I’ll start populating the evidence_matrix.xlsx for Data protection and will need the KMS audit CSV from infra (Jonas) and the key rotation SOP (internal doc link) by tomorrow noon.

If any of the owners above can’t commit, reply with alternate owner. I’ll also push a short shared drive folder for assembled artifacts (see link).

-Marissa
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
